title: Self-supervised Attribute-aware Dynamic Preference Ranking Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigated by applying a time decay function to popularity attributes (e.g., votes, likes) and using a logarithmic scale to smooth extreme values, preventing older but outdated responses from dominating preference rankings.
Addressed during the evaluation and annotation phase by explicitly prompting evaluators (human or AI) to ensure that the presentation order of the candidate responses does not affect their judgment.
Addressed in the evaluation rules by instructing that the length of the candidate answers should not impact the ranking evaluation, aiming to isolate semantic relevance and timeliness.
